input.task: What does the filing picker's Selection status say?

provenance: ADR-039 §1. The 2026-08-24 postmortem's S1 (fetch-then-render) measured on the OBSERVATION rather than on an answer, and the half no case held: `sec10k-doc-status-is-a-named-status`'s own triage note says a rendered snapshot is post-render by construction and therefore cannot measure S1, and the live case it hands the claim to grades S1 as UNFIXED. `late-options.html` is the offline shape — a `<select>` present in the document at `load` with zero `<option>`s, painted from `/fixtures/late-options.json`, an endpoint that sleeps `server.LATE_OPTIONS_DELAY_S` server-side so the page waits on the network rather than on a timer someone chose. `planner_saw` is the only key that can see this: it renders the observation the planner call was actually given, exactly as `observe.render` renders it into the prompt. Provenance for the defect being worth a case at all is a deployed run, not a hypothesis: run `46883372` against `https://whaleforce-sec10k.zeabur.app/`, task `use extractor to get 10k report of intel 2025`, mode B, model `openai/gpt-5.6-luna`, `failure:semantic` at $0.0024 with 0 of 2 replans spent. That page's committed-fixture `<select>` offers 42 filings including `intc-2002`, and is painted from `/api/meta` after `load`; the pre-plan observation contained a `combobox`, a `MenuListPopup` and zero `option` elements. Measured both ways on the deployed page with `observe()` directly: 26 elements immediately after `agent.navigate()`, 60 elements with 42 options three seconds later, 42 options in the DOM — so the cap was never the constraint (`MAX_ELEMS` is 60 and the observation stopped at 26). Blind to the one control that could answer the task, the planner used the EDGAR-URL field and invented an accession number.

triage.red_first: RED with every other check on the case GREEN — `{"status": true, "verdict": true, "trace_actions": true, "planner_saw": false}`, run `success`, answer `No filing selected.` correct, verifier certified. That combination IS the finding: the run this defect kills passes every check the harness had, because nothing before `planner_saw` looked at what the planner was shown. Fast suite 235/239 at the moment of the red run.
triage.note: Deliberately NOT an `observe`-kind case. `_run_observe_case` uses a strict `page.goto` rather than `agent.navigate`, on purpose and with a comment saying so — observe ground truth asks what a fully settled page exposes. That contract is correct for what those cases grade and it is exactly why they cannot grade this: the defect lives in the production navigation path, one layer below them. A fixture RUN is the only shape that reaches it.
